rag.text:
Test: TC-4169 — Box Module - Scope - Basic operations - Detail View on JC 
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-106 Box Module - Scope - Basic operations

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Scope module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4169 Box Module - Scope - Basic operations - Detail View on JC
   Expected: Scope module is presented with 1 task
2. Expand Detail View if close
   Expected: The splashscreen ""Select a task first. Then view its details here with the multi-level hierarchy in sight."" is visible
3. Click on taskSummary
   Data: taskSummary: Task A
   Expected: On top of the frame on left side project/task key links are visible, on the right side 'Quick preview' option.

Detail View is presented with 5 sections: 

* Details
* People
* Estimations (Original estimation, Remaining estimation, Time spent, Story Points fields in this sections )
* Dates
* Others
4. Change size of Detail View
   Expected: The sections are responsive. Between section the same space during size changing.
5. Expand and collapse sectionsName1, sectionsName2, sectionsName3, sectionsName4, sectionsName5
   Data: sectionsName1: Details

sectionsName2: People

sectionsName3: Estimations

sectionsName4: Dates

sectionsName5: Others
   Expected: Sections are responsive, works smoothly without jumping.
6. On top of Detail View click on Open full view
   Expected: Jira Issue modal is opened
7. Close task window, On Detail View change the fields on newValueSummary, newValuePriority, newValueStartDate.
   Data: newValueSummary: Task New Name

newValuePriority: Low

newValueStartDate: 03/Apr/23
   Expected: New field's values are changed correctly
8. Double click on fieldName , fieldName1
   Data: fieldName: Original estimate

fieldName1: Story Points
   Expected: The fields are editable.
